gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Redux spaces its letters out wide and lets every curve swing in through a visible entry stroke. Noto Sans Old Sogdian follows in a tall-lowercase sans that stays crisp and open, so the heading gets the drama and the text gets out of its way.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: A visible entry stroke leads into every curve of Redux, spread across generous spacing and an enlarged lowercase. And Noto Sans Sundanese keeps a long page moving, with open-mouthed e crossbars and capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Spaced-out and geometric, with strokes that vary just enough to feel alive. Noto Sans Telugu then carries a long page smoothly, its high midline and connected counters keeping the text quiet.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-yi: Redux stretches its spacing wide and enlarges the lowercase, giving headings a modern, geometric presence. But Noto Sans Yi does the steadier work, with a deep midsection and open rounds that keep running text easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-numans: Numans reads wide and loose, its lowercase swollen and its s hanging open far from the spine. And Redux above it brings spaced-out geometry and curved entry strokes, with stems just heavier than hairlines.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-orienta: Redux sets wide spacing and a visible entry stroke into each curve, with an enlarged lowercase. And Orienta's open counters and small gap between upper and lowercase make it a fine sans-serif for text at a modest size.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-oxygen: Contemporary and geometric, Redux spreads its letters wide and lets curves enter with a visible lead-in. Oxygen keeps its curves unclosed and its lowercase close to the capitals, so a long page reads smoothly beneath that heading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-pathway-extreme: Wide, geometric and slightly showy, Redux enters each curve with a clear lead-in stroke. Pathway Extreme brings stubby ascenders and a large x-height, so a sans body at a generous size stays open and easy to take in.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-pt-sans-caption: Redux is defined by its wide spacing and the visible entry into each curve, plus an enlarged lowercase. And PT Sans Caption brings open bowls and big-bodied letters, so the heading earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-questrial: The visible entry stroke into every curve gives Redux its character, along with wide spacing and enlarged lowercase. Questrial answers in a single weight, with open c, e and s shapes, so a sans body at a slightly larger size feels crisp and flat.
